input:
EARLIER SCENES (context only):
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。
这个城市老是很吵，不是人吵架，就是都叫，害得孟子一直不能睡觉。在那儿，孟母也找不到工作。孟子和妈妈要又一个次搬了家。在第三个城市，孟母找到工作，在商店做衣服。
CURRENT SCENE:
孟子在那个商店也找了到工作，可是不是做衣服的工作，而是喜欢的工作。孟子学习馆学了十五年，他的学习和他的旅行经验很重要，对他很多好处。他是大人的时候，他成为很有名的哲人。

FLAGGED PLACES:

[P124] 孟子在那个商店也【找了到】工作
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: 孟子在那个商店也[找了→找到了]到工作 (her pattern: 找了 -> 找到了 (corrected 3/5 in train))
  proposed by the AI checker: 孟子在那个商店也找[了到→到了]工作 (了 follows 到 in 找到)
  her past correction (zai_progressive): 孟子不是[-在]看商店的员工 — her note: here is not emphasizing “ongoing”
  her past correction (word_class_choice): 孟母找到一个[打工→打工的工作]
  her past correction (collocation_selection): 孟母找到了[良好的→好]工作 — her note: 良好is not with工作
  rule card search_find: 找 means “look for.” Use 找到 when the person successfully finds something. Not an error: Do not use this rule when the meaning is only “look for” and does not include a successful result.
  rule card zai_progressive: Use 在/正在 before a dynamic verb when the action is ongoing; use 一直在+V. to emphasize that it is always ongoing. Do not use 在 when the sentence only states what someone does and does not emphasize an ongoing action. Not an error: Do not flag a sentence for lacking 在 when it only states what someone does and does not emphasize an ongoing action.

[P125] 可是不是做衣服的工作【，而是喜欢的工作】
  proposed by the correction model: 可是不是做衣服的工作[-，而是喜欢的工作]
  her past correction (modifier_de_structure): 就是做冬天[+的]衣服
  her past correction (zhe_durative): 她[穿→穿着]很漂亮的衣服 — her note: 着durative
  her past correction (modifier_de_structure): 穿上一件蓝色[-的]衣服的人
  rule card modifier_de_structure: Use 的 after a modifier when it describes a noun, especially a longer phrase such as 人类创造的文明 or 能吃的植物. Do not add 的 after quantity words or fixed modifiers where it is not needed, such as 很多人, 一些人, 今天清晨, 蓝色衣服, and 好主意. Not an error: Do not flag 的 in modifiers that need it, such as 有毒的植物, 中国的植物, or 穿着蓝色衣服的人. Do not add 的 after short fixed modifiers such as 很多, 一些, 今天, 蓝色, or 好 in the examples shown.
  rule card zhe_durative: Use 着 for a durative, accompanying, or static state. When one action accompanies the main action, use V.着 + V2 (for example, 牵着驴走). Not an error: Do not use 着 when the action is completed, such as 吃了夹竹桃以后 (了completed). Do not change 和/跟 + noun when both nouns perform the same action.

[P126] 孟子【学习馆】学了十五年
  proposed by the AI checker: 孟子[+在]学习馆学了十五年 (location needs 在 before it)
  proposed by the AI checker: 孟子[学习馆→学校]学了十五年 (学习馆 is not the normal word for school)
  her past correction (zai_progressive): 孟子[一直学了→一直在学习]很多东西 — her note: 一直在+V., emphasizing always ongoing
  her past correction (laoshi_negative_repetition): 所以孟子[老是→一直]在学习 — her note: “老是“ for something negative, used to complain
  her past correction (laoshi_negative_repetition): 孟子[跟老师老是学习中文→一直学习中文] — her note: “老是“ for something negative, used to complain
  rule card laoshi_negative_repetition: 老是 means “always” and is used for something negative or to complain; for a neutral or positive repeated action, use 一直 or 常常 instead. Not an error: Use 老是 when the repeated action is negative or the speaker is complaining about it. Do not flag it merely because it means “always.”
  rule card zai_progressive: Use 在/正在 before a dynamic verb when the action is ongoing; use 一直在+V. to emphasize that it is always ongoing. Do not use 在 when the sentence only states what someone does and does not emphasize an ongoing action. Not an error: Do not flag a sentence for lacking 在 when it only states what someone does and does not emphasize an ongoing action.

[P127] 对他【^】很多好处
  proposed by the AI checker: 对他[+有]很多好处 (对他有很多好处 needs 有)
  proposed by the correction model: 对他[+有]很多好处
  her past correction (redundant_words): 因为他们觉得[祭拜有很多好处，对他们的生活→对生活有很多好处]
  her past correction (redundant_words): 因为[-他们]觉得祭拜有很多好处 — her note: redundant
  her past correction (modifier_de_structure): 他[+的]朋友帮他
  rule card redundant_words: Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea. Not an error: Do not delete a word if it adds a different meaning, such as a different time, person, or detail. Only flag words or structures that repeat information already expressed.
  rule card modifier_de_structure: Use 的 after a modifier when it describes a noun, especially a longer phrase such as 人类创造的文明 or 能吃的植物. Do not add 的 after quantity words or fixed modifiers where it is not needed, such as 很多人, 一些人, 今天清晨, 蓝色衣服, and 好主意. Not an error: Do not flag 的 in modifiers that need it, such as 有毒的植物, 中国的植物, or 穿着蓝色衣服的人. Do not add 的 after short fixed modifiers such as 很多, 一些, 今天, 蓝色, or 好 in the examples shown.

[P128] 他【是大人的时候】
  proposed by the AI checker: 他[是大人的时候→长大后] (长大后 is the natural time expression)
  her past correction (fixed_expressions): [是大人的时候→长大以后]
  her past correction (fixed_expressions): [大人的时候→长大以后]
  her past correction (time_sequence_markers): [长大的时候→长大以后]
  rule card fixed_expressions: Use established fixed expressions and compounds, rather than literal or self-created word combinations. For example, use 自然规律, 制定规定, and 从 + Place. Not an error: Do not flag 人山人海 when it describes a scene where many people are gathered in a space.
  rule card time_sequence_markers: Use Time + 以后 after a completed time or action to show “after”; when moving to a later event in the story, use 后来 or 然后 rather than 以后 by itself. Do not add 以后 when the time phrase already says the time clearly. Not an error: Do not use 结果 merely as a general later-time connector; it is for an unexpected result. Use 后来 for a later development instead.

[P129] 【他】成为很有名的哲人
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: [-他]成为很有名的哲人 (他 repeats the subject of the clause before: zero form)
  her past correction (become_and_profession): 他成为[有名的→有名的哲学家] — her note: 成为+N
  her past correction (time_sequence_markers): [+后来]他成为一个有名的哲学家 — her note: “他” is ambiguous, 后来成为
  her past correction (incorrect_story_information): [他成为很有名的老师→哲学家]
  rule card zero_redundant_pronoun: When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是. Not an error: Do not delete a subject when it is needed before 不是……而是……; place it before 不是 instead.
  rule card become_and_profession: 成为 is followed by an appropriate N., especially a profession or public identity: 成为 + N. (profession/celebrity). For becoming successful or capable, use 成才. Not an error: Do not flag 成为 when it is followed by an appropriate noun, especially a profession or public identity, such as 成为哲学家.

[P130] 他成为【^】很有名的哲人
  proposed by the correction model: 他成为[+了]很有名的哲人
  her past correction (become_and_profession): 他成为[有名的→有名的哲学家] — her note: 成为+N
  her past correction (le_completed): 他成为[+了]哲学家
  her past correction (time_sequence_markers): [+后来]他成为一个有名的哲学家 — her note: “他” is ambiguous, 后来成为
  rule card become_and_profession: 成为 is followed by an appropriate N., especially a profession or public identity: 成为 + N. (profession/celebrity). For becoming successful or capable, use 成才. Not an error: Do not flag 成为 when it is followed by an appropriate noun, especially a profession or public identity, such as 成为哲学家.
  rule card le_completed: Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb. Not an error: Do not flag an action just because it has a verb: if it is not about completion, no 了. An ongoing action can use 着 instead of 了.

places.reason: Successful finding requires 找到; the aspect marker follows 到.
喜欢的工作 is grammatically acceptable and the contrast is coherent.
学习馆 is not the normal word for school, and the location needs 在.
对他有很多好处 requires 有.
长大以后 is the established expression for this later life stage.
The subject is already clear from the close preceding clause.
Becoming a philosopher is a completed change of state in the narrative.
